summary: Program catalogue built declaratively (DES-02): Program__c (Public Read/Write internal OWD, Private external) with Program_Code__c (Text(20), required, unique, case-insensitive, External Id), restricted Study_Level__c and Faculty__c picklists, Active__c (default true); Active_Programs and All list views; layout, compact layout and search layouts; Programs tab added to the Recruitment app; Persona_Recruitment_Officer gains Program Read/Create/Edit (no Delete), FLS and tab visibility. ADR 0002 records the decision accepted on #4. All 20 Apex tests and 7 Playwright tests pass in the agent sandbox.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldLetRecruitmentOfficerCreateProgramWithAllFields, shouldOfferExactlyTheThreeStudyLevelsAsRestrictedPicklist, shouldOfferExactlyTheFiveFacultiesAsRestrictedPicklist, shouldDefaultNewProgramsToActive, shouldCreate200ProgramsInOneTransaction; Playwright '#4 AC1: Recruitment Officer creates a Program with code, study level, faculty and active'

ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldMakeProgramCodeAUniqueRequiredExternalId, shouldRejectDuplicateProgramCode, shouldRejectDuplicateProgramCodeInDifferentCase, shouldRequireProgramCode; Playwright '#4 AC2: saving a duplicate Program Code shows a duplicate-value error'

ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldLetRecruitmentOfficerEditAProgramCreatedBySomeoneElse, shouldGrantProgramAccessThroughPermissionSetNotProfile, shouldRefuseProgramDeleteToRecruitmentOfficer, shouldRefuseProgramCreationToMinimumAccessPersona, shouldRefuseProgramReadToMinimumAccessPersona; Playwright '#4 AC3: Recruitment Officer edits a Program's study level and active flag', '#4 AC3: Recruitment Officer cannot delete a Program (denial, TST-03)'

ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldShipActiveProgramsListViewVisibleToRecruitmentOfficer, shouldShowProgramsTabInRecruitmentApp; Playwright '#4 AC4: Programs tab opens the Active Programs list showing only active programs'

testChanges: Apex in this sandbox runs SOQL and DML in user mode by default, and the test runner (System Administrator) holds no FLS on Program fields. TestDataFactory.createPrograms and the system-side read-back in shouldLetRecruitmentOfficerEditAProgramCreatedBySomeoneElse now say SYSTEM_MODE explicitly (APX-22). Persona code paths are unchanged and still run in user mode.
shouldGrantProgramAccessThroughPermissionSetNotProfile: field describes are now read inside System.runAs. Outside it they reported the admin's FLS, not the persona's.

Denial tests also accept the exception types user mode actually throws: TypeException 'DML operation DELETE not allowed' (checked by message) and SecurityException on read. Each still asserts that the operation was refused and that no data changed.

shouldShowProgramsTabInRecruitmentApp: Schema.describeTabs() lists Classic apps only, and Recruitment is a Lightning app. The test now checks, as the persona, that AppDefinition 'Recruitment' is visible and its AppTabMember includes Program__c, and that Persona_Recruitment_Officer has the Program__c tab visible.

Playwright: the record URL check accepts /lightning/r/<id>/view as well as the form with the object name. Picklist selection retries and then verifies the chosen value. View-mode Active is read from its Details field (True/False), because Lightning does not render it as a checkbox there. The AC2 field check accepts the platform's 'Program_Code__c' wording (plan decision 4). AC2's 'not saved' URL check is now stricter (any record page).
openQuestions: PIPE-15: the harness clean-up of E2E-* Programs in QA (plan decision 6b) is not in this repo yet. It is outside what a story may change (global-setup.ts is integration's copy).
DM-04 / RET-01: Data_Retention_Policy__mdt does not exist in this repo yet. The Program policy row (Retain Indefinitely, ADR 0002) is added when the retention engine lands.
